sections.body:

sections.heading: what this *isn't*
sections.body:
Nearly every outcome attached here is still pending tracking, so none of the strategy has been checked against a result. The wargame verdict was conditional and whether its fixes were applied is unverified.

Session ledgers keep only the last 10 files per session and are pruned at 7 days, so file counts are a floor, not a census. Sweeps persist their own record, so anything already swept is kept.
